Select: canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source: metabolism, compound_records (substrate), compound_structures (substrate), molecule_dictionary (parent). Join: metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records (substrate).record_id; compound_records (substrate).molregno = compound_structures (substrate).molregno; metabolism.drug_record_id = compound_records (parent).record_id; compound_records (parent).molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Filter: metabolism.organism = 'Canis lupus familiaris'. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, substrate_compound_name ASC, parent_compound_name ASC, met_conversion ASC, pathway_key ASC, organism ASC, enzyme_name ASC. Limit: 200.
